profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | Digital Platform Lead | Web Applications, Integrations & Workflow Automation
profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Sarah Clark, a full-stack web developer who builds practical, scalable solutions that connect technology, people, and business processes.

My work includes custom web applications, digital platforms, API and CRM integrations, workflow automation, analytics, and cloud-based solutions. I enjoy solving problems that go beyond simply building a website, connecting systems, automating processes, personalizing user experiences, and turning complex requirements into tools that make work easier.

My work spans the full project lifecycle, from gathering requirements and defining the technical approach through development, testing, deployment, optimization, troubleshooting, and ongoing platform strategy. I collaborate closely with technical teams, leadership, marketing, business intelligence, and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into practical, user-friendly solutions.

I’m naturally curious and enjoy learning new technologies and finding better ways to build. I also use AI-assisted tools to explore ideas, accelerate development, troubleshoot problems, and improve efficiency while applying independent judgment, testing, and quality assurance.

Before moving into development, my background included design, business ownership, and team leadership. With more than 14 years of professional experience, I bring a combination of technical knowledge, creativity, business understanding, and project leadership to the way I approach development.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Lead development and technical strategy for a private, multi-state employee intranet that centralizes communications, resources, events, benefits, forms, and operational tools.
- Architect custom WordPress applications, plugins, REST API endpoints, routing systems, administrative tools, and scheduled processes using PHP, JavaScript, SQL, and WordPress APIs.
- Built personalized content delivery using campus, state, employee-group, and role-based permissions so employees receive relevant information based on their location and responsibilities.
- Develop and maintain automated employee-data synchronization, account provisioning, role assignment, Microsoft Single Sign-On, and access-management workflows.
- Integrate HubSpot, Gravity Forms, booking tools, Eventbrite, GA4, GTM, and internal systems to automate enrollment journeys and improve lead and campaign attribution.
- Managed migration of the platform from Microsoft Azure to Nexcess, including planning, configuration, testing, deployment, performance monitoring, and issue resolution.
- Partner with Marketing, Enrollment, BI, IT, leadership, and campus stakeholders to gather requirements, prioritize enhancements, communicate progress, manage releases, and support adoption.
- Implemented caching, query optimization, automated communications, delivery controls, and monitoring to improve platform performance, stability, and reliability.
